title: Basic Level 1 Arrays 16

content.problemStatement:
Given an array of both the positive integers ans the negative integers, write a program to count the pair for the given difference



Note : Pair should be counted only once



For Example:

The input array is :{3,34,-5,12,78,14,8,17,58}

The given sum is : 20

The output is : 2

Explanation:

when we subtract 34 & 14 we will get 20

78-58=20



Hence the pair count is 2.
content.inputFormat:
First line contains the size of the array.

Second line contains the array elements.

Third line contains the difference.

solution.approach: Process inputs via standard stream input and apply required transformations.

hints: Can sorting the array simplify the problem, or does sorting take too long compared to a hash table lookup?
Consider two-pointer approaches if the array is sorted, or a sliding window if looking for contiguous subarrays.
Prefix sums or prefix XORs can answer range sum queries in O(1) time after O(N) preprocessing.
